name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly while volunteering at a local rally as a teenager. He was immediately captivated by the blend of engineering precision and raw adrenaline. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from Cardiff University, he joined a small engineering firm specializing in motorsport components, honing his skills in materials science and stress analysis. He quickly became known for his meticulous attention to detail.

His current role at JOTA Sport allows him to apply his expertise to ensure the highest standards of performance and reliability. Gareth is not just focused on meeting specifications; he anticipates potential problems and proactively develops solutions. He takes pride in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, always seeking ways to refine processes and enhance the quality of the team's output. What distinguishes Gareth is his ability to combine a rigorous analytical approach with an intuitive understanding of the demands of high-performance racing.

physical.description: Gareth has a serious, focused expression and a solid build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on using a traditional slide rule for certain calculations, despite having access to advanced software.
